description: 100% line coverage, but findall skips text it does not recognise: '100ms' parses as 100 minutes.
notes: canned demo review; not produced by a model

evidence.what_it_exercises: Asserts seconds for five well-formed strings from 0s to 1d2h3m4s.
Asserts ValueError only when no token at all is present (never, h, empty).
Property over well-formed token runs; never generates text with unknown units or garbage.

missing_input_classes.name: text:multi-letter-unit
missing_input_classes.description: A unit longer than one letter, e.g. "100ms".
missing_input_classes.why_likely: The token regex matches 100m and drops the s, so parse_duration('100ms') returns 6000 seconds instead of raising: a typo becomes a window 60,000 times too long.

missing_input_classes.name: text:decimal
missing_input_classes.why_likely: The regex skips '1.' and reads 5h, so '1.5h' is 18000 seconds instead of an error.

missing_input_classes.name: text:trailing-garbage
missing_input_classes.description: Trailing text after the last unit, e.g. "5m!".
missing_input_classes.why_likely: Unrecognised text between or after tokens is ignored instead of rejected.

suggested_tests.name: test_parse_duration_consumes_whole_input

invariant_findings.evidence: parse_duration('100ms') returns 6000: the token regex consumes '100m' and the trailing 's' is silently ignored instead of raising ValueError.
